surface.host: every generated /help locale page, inside the M10-01 assistant entry beside deterministic search

transcript.layout: bounded to min(40dvh, 20rem), independently scrollable, with contained overscroll

surface.status: polite atomic status region reserved for stable availability and progress keys
surface.sources: a named, initially hidden ordered source list; it cannot contain a source until a validated final answer exists

controls.reason: No assistant request route is enabled yet. Disabled controls are not in the tab order and their visible explanation names the unavailable state.

accessibility.names: Every form control, transcript, sources section, answer-state region and control group has a localized programmatic name.
accessibility.focus: The static unavailable state creates no new tab stop. A later enabled implementation must keep focus in the question field or on the user-invoked control; stream or status updates must never move focus.
accessibility.keyboard: When enabled by a later security-cleared task, the native Send, Stop and Clear buttons are the only activation path; this static state has no fake client-side action.
accessibility.announcements: Status uses a polite atomic live region and the transcript uses a polite non-atomic log. No raw model token or unsafe content is rendered by this task.
accessibility.visual: The transcript is bounded, narrow layouts stack actions, reduced-motion remains globally respected, and forced-colors preserves borders for the surface controls.

security_and_resource_boundaries.reason: AI093-T05, AI093-T06 and AI093-T07 remain M10 release blockers. This task adds only inert semantic markup and CSS; it makes no request, no browser-side rendering sink and no worker allocation.
